definitions.fall: first body tilt >45 degrees (includes sideways falls)
definitions.recovery: first <2 degree body tilt interval lasting 0.5s after 0.1s torque pulse; null if absent
definitions.output_error: applied clipped output minus LQR on the SAME state and filter history, rad/s
definitions.inference_error: INT8 minus original NumPy predictor on shared held-out states, rad/s
definitions.timing: single-thread desktop wall time, I/O normalization included; excludes physics and sensing
definitions.fp32: existing FP32 trained weights; original NumPy predictor computes in float64
definitions.summary: unweighted episode means; maximum is global maximum; stress failures reported separately
